html:
G'oya

Har bir kurs natijada qolishi kerak, talabasi bo'lmasa ham. Shuning uchun courses ga enrollments ni LEFT JOIN qilamiz, keyin kurs bo'yicha guruhlab, ulangan yozilishlarni sanaymiz.

Yechim

SELECT c.title, COUNT(e.student_id) AS students
FROM courses c
LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.title

COUNT(e.student_id) faqat NULL bo'lmagan qiymatlarni sanaydi. Talabasiz kurs uchun LEFT JOIN bitta qator yasaydi, unda e.student_id NULL, shuning uchun natija 0. Guruhni c.id belgilaydi, c.title esa uni SELECT da ko'rsatish uchun qo'shilgan.

Tuzoqlar

COUNT(*) qiymatlarni emas, qatorlarni sanaydi. Namunadagi Statistika kursiga hech kim yozilmagan, lekin LEFT JOIN dan keyin u bitta qator bo'lib turadi va COUNT(*) 1 qaytaradi:

Noto'g'riSELECT c.title, COUNT(*) AS students
FROM courses c
LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.title

GROUP BY c.title ham xato. Ikkita "Python" kursi bo'lsa, ularning talabalari bitta qatorga qo'shilib ketadi, shart esa ularni alohida sanashni so'raydi.

Oddiy JOIN bilan talabasiz kurslar natijaga umuman kirmaydi.
